_comment: 12.1 PTR build feed — one entry per PTR build's development notes. Canonical source: the official forum thread (each build = a new reply post; machine-readable via .json Discourse endpoint). Discovered via Wowhead news RSS. Newest first.

builds.label: Follow-up notes (forum post #19): Vaults of Atal'utek Corrosive Souls tracking + Omnium Folio questline account-wide skip (no class tuning)
highlights: Non-class: Vaults of Atal'utek — the Corrosive Codex now shows a counter for Corrosive Souls, tracking how many are in the character's inventory.
Non-class: The Omnium Folio introduction questline can now be skipped on other characters once any character on the account has completed it.

builds.label: Week of July 31st — Class Tuning & Tier Sets: broad PvE tuning across Death Knight (San'layn Blood pullback, Unholy AoE-to-melee shift), Demon Hunter (Havoc buffs / Devourer cleave trim), Druid (Balance nerf, Guardian +8%), Devastation Evoker (Scintillation fix + baseline compensation), Hunter (BM/MM cuts), Mage (Arcane single-target, Fire +6%, Frost set + cleave trims), Paladin/Priest Holy healing +5%, Shadow spread-cleave trim, Rogue aura buffs to all three specs, Elemental Shaman Farseer Ancestor cuts, Warlock single-target buffs with a Destruction cleave trim, and Warrior (Arms trim + set rework, Protection +6%); plus Venomous Abyss tier-set changes, Season 2 Delve/Ritual Site/Void Assault reward updates and PvP tuning.
highlights: Blood Death Knight — San'layn pullback (dev note: overperforming in AoE and low target cleave): Blood is Life now accumulates 15% of the damage dealt from the Blood Beast (was 25%); Frenzied Bloodthirst's Death Strike and Death Coil damage bonus reduced to 5% per stack (was 6%); Visceral Strength now grants 10% Strength (was 12%).

Unholy Death Knight — Area damage reined in and personal melee raised (dev note): auto-attack damage increased by 100%; Virulent Plague -10%, Epidemic -12%, Apex Talent Forbidden Knowledge Graveyard -15%; The Venomous Abyss set bonus — damage of Necrotic Bolt and Withering Grasp increased by 25%.

Havoc Demon Hunter — Dev note: "Havoc is a little further behind in damage than our target." Blade Dance, Death Sweep, Chaos Strike and Annihilation damage each increased by 6%; The Hunt +12%; Essence Break initial damage +10% and secondary damage +30%.
Devourer Demon Hunter — Low-target cleave trimmed: Eradicate secondary target damage reduced by 15%; Annihilator: Final Hour now causes Voidfall bonuses to persist for 6 seconds (was 8 seconds).

Balance Druid — Dev note: overall damage reduced with a slightly larger cut to spread cleave, which remains a Balance strength. Moonfire and Sunfire -5%, Shooting Stars -10%, Starsurge and Starfall -3%, Meteorites -15%.
Guardian Druid — All damage increased by 8%.

Devastation Evoker — Scintillation interaction fixed and the set corrected, with baseline compensation (dev note): Shattering Stars released from Eternity Surge via Scintillation are now subject to Scintillation's 40% effectiveness multiplier; The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — Shattering Star damage bonus reduced to 50% (was 150%); Deep Breath +30%, Pyre +10%, Disintegrate +40%, Living Flame +50%.
Beast Mastery Hunter — Cobra Shot damage reduced by 20%.
Marksmanship Hunter — Dev note: bug fixes had increased its damage, so tuning realigns it with other DPS specs. All damage dealt by you and your pets reduced by 5%; Explosive Shot -33%.

Arcane Mage — Dev note: AoE is fine but single target is behind target. Arcane Blast damage increased by 20%; Spellslinger: Splintering Orbs damage bonus to Arcane Orb increased to 50% (was 10%); Sunfury: fixed Meteorites not granting Clearcasting.
Fire Mage — All damage increased by 6%.

Frost Mage — Dev note: the tier set was providing more throughput than intended and 2-target cleave was slightly high, so both are trimmed alongside an overall damage increase. The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — Glacial Spike damage bonus reduced to 20% (was 25%), chance to generate an Icicle per Freezing stack Shattered reduced to 4% (was 5%); The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus — Shatter damage bonus reduced to 5% (was 10%); Splitting Ice — Flurry and Frostbolt effectiveness against the second target reduced to 50% (was 80%); Fractured Frost — Ice Lance effectiveness against the second target reduced to 50% (was 100%); all damage increased by 3%.
Holy Paladin — All healing increased by 5%.
Holy Priest — All healing increased by 5%.

Shadow Priest — Spread-cleave pullback (dev note: Shadow is expected to keep excelling there afterwards). Void Volley damage reduced by 10%; The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus now causes Tentacle Slam to grant a free use of Void Volley at 100% effectiveness (was 125%); Archon: Focused Outburst now increases Void Volley damage by 5% (was 15%).
Assassination Rogue — All damage dealt increased by 10%.
Outlaw Rogue — All damage dealt increased by 6%. This does not apply to PvP combat.
Subtlety Rogue — All damage dealt increased by 10%. This does not apply to PvP combat.

Elemental Shaman — Dev note: Farseer's Ancestor spells are performing higher than wanted after their earlier boost. Farseer: Ancestors' Lava Burst damage reduced by 20%; Farseer: Ancestors' Chain Lightning damage reduced by 20%.
Affliction Warlock — Haunt now increases your damage dealt to the target by 16% for 18 seconds (was 12%).

Demonology Warlock — Shadow Bolt damage increased by 45%, Demonbolt +55%, Summon Gloomhound +35%; fixed a tooltip issue where the Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus stated it would cast Implosion at 125% and 150% effectiveness rather than the intended 225% and 250% effectiveness.

Destruction Warlock — Dev note: all three Warlock specs gain single-target damage while Destruction's cleave profile is reduced, keeping its 2-target edge "at a reasonable amount." Havoc now causes spells to deal 50% of their damage to the marked target (was 60%); Soul Fire +45%, Chaos Bolt +5%.

Arms Warrior — Dev note: single-target and cleave slightly reduced, and the set bonuses adjusted so the current tier set is more rewarding than mixing older pieces. Powerful Momentum now increases Sweeping Strikes chain damage by 20% (was 25%); Execute damage reduced by 15%; Midnight Season 1 2-set bonus now increases Colossus Smash damage by 3% (was 5%); The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus — Mortal Strike and Overpower now increase the damage of your next Slam by 20% (was 10%) and stack up to 5 times (was 3).
Protection Warrior — All damage increased by 6%.
Delves — "Prey: Anguish from Beyond" daily now awards 35 Coffer Key Shards; Coiled Isles World Quests award 100 Coffer Key Shards when Shards are the primary reward.

Events — Ritual Site tiers 1-6 vault rewards now match the Season 2 Delve tiers and award Season 2 crests (tiers 1-3 keep Season 1 item levels; tiers 4/5/6 recommended item levels raised to 259/268/275, and Tier 6 Advanced Ritual Studies no longer offers a Nebulous Voidcore bonus roll). Void Assaults, Void-Touched Caches and the Val/Naigtal world content all move to Season 2 Adventurer/Veteran crests and gear; Season 1 gear caches removed and the World Boss drops stay Season 1 and can no longer be upgraded.

Player versus Player — Gladiator's Distinction (PvP trinket bonus) now increases primary stat by 15% (was 12%) and Stamina by 5% (was 10%) for tank and damage dealer roles, and Stamina by 10% (was 15%) for healers; PvP-only tuning for Devourer Demon Hunter, Restoration Druid, Mistweaver Monk, Holy/Protection/Retribution Paladin, Discipline Priest, Subtlety Rogue and Arms Warrior.

builds.label: Week of July 23rd — Class Bug Fixes & Tuning: mostly bug fixes across Hunter (BM/MM/Survival), Evoker (Preservation) and Monk, plus targeted tuning — Restoration Druid Regrowth -20%, Mistweaver Morning Breeze rebalance, Holy Paladin Venomous Abyss 4-set mana-cost change + healing buff, Discipline Priest Void Shield. PTR marked a release candidate.
highlights: Restoration Druid — Regrowth healing reduced by 20%; fixed Abundance's bonus crit chance to Regrowth not working and the Abundance effect not being extended by Flourish.
Preservation Evoker — Fixed Consume Flame healing not being increased by Grace Period or similar effects; Fluttering Seedlings healing is now also increased by Titan's Gift.
Beast Mastery Hunter — Fixed Dark Ranger's Through The Eyes not properly increasing Withering Fire's damage.

Marksmanship Hunter — Multiple fixes: Spotter's Mark: Rapid Fire consumption, Aspect of the Hydra + Deathblow/Deathbringer interactions, and Explosive Shot's explosion incorrectly hitting its primary target.
Survival Hunter — Fixed Raptor Swipe's Sentinel's Mark targeting, Outland Venom not being applied by Pack Leader periodic effects, and Mastery: Spirit Bond double-affecting some Pack Leader summons.
Brewmaster Monk — Fixed Flurry Strikes' Physical damage not being correctly increased by Bring Me Another or the Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus.

Mistweaver Monk — Morning Breeze effectiveness reduced by 60%, adjusted down in accordance with the Mastery: Gust of Mist increases in Curse of Ula'tek (dev note: leaves the talent at a similar overall level).
Holy Paladin — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus now additionally increases Holy Light's mana cost by 60% (to curb over-efficiency); All healing increased by 5% to compensate.
Discipline Priest — Apex Talent Master the Darkness: Void Shield absorption increased by 3%.

builds.label: Week of July 21st — Class Tuning & Tier Sets: PvE tuning for Death Knight (Blood/Unholy + San'layn), Demon Hunter (Havoc/Devourer/Vengeance), Druid (Balance/Feral), Evoker (Augmentation/Devastation), Hunter (BM/MM rework/Survival + Hunter's Mark reverted to 1 target), Mage (Arcane), Paladin (Protection/Retribution), Rogue (Assassination/Outlaw/Subtlety), Restoration Shaman rework, Warlock (Affliction rework/Demonology), Warrior (Arms/Fury/Protection); plus Venomous Abyss tier-set changes and Season 2 dungeon testing (July 21–27).
highlights: Blood Death Knight Melee damage increased by 20%, Heart Strike +25%, Marrowrend +50%; Dancing Rune Weapon now increases Parry by 30% (was 25%); Perseverance of the Ebon Blade duration increased to 10s (was 6s); Apex Talent Dance of Midnight (Rank 2) damage reduction per Dancing Rune Weapon now 6% (was 4%).
Unholy Death Knight Epidemic damage increased by 75%, Virulent Plague +50%, Putrefy AoE +35%; Apex Talent Forbidden Knowledge Graveyard damage +15%.

Death Knight (San'layn) Blood-Soaked Ground now reduces physical damage taken by 8% (was 5%), Blood Beast auto-attack +1400%, Pact of the San'layn now stores 15% of all Shadow damage dealt (was 10%), Vampiric Strike +25%.

Havoc Demon Hunter All damage increased by 5%, Essence Break initial damage +35%, Immolation Aura -8%; Fury generation smoothed (Burning Hatred now +30 Fury was +40, Demon Blades 10–16 per attack was 8–15).
Havoc Demon Hunter The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus now increases Essence Break's initial damage by 35% (was 25%).
Devourer Demon Hunter Collapsing Star damage increased by 12%, Eradicate reduced by 6%; Annihilator's Otherworldly Focus single-target Collapsing Star/Voidfall Meteor bonus now 30% (was 35%).
Vengeance Demon Hunter All damage increased by 5.5%.

Balance Druid Solar Bolt damage +15%; Stellar Amplification now only applies to 1 target; Elune's Chosen Star Cascade now has a 30% chance to launch a Starsurge at 50% effectiveness (was 40% at 70%); Keeper of the Grove Dream Burst +30% and Power of Nature treant melee +300% (was 200%); Orbit Breaker Full Moon effectiveness bug fixed.
Feral Druid Rampant Ferocity damage increased by 25%.
Augmentation Evoker All ability and pet damage increased by 3%; Scalecommander Wingleader now reduces Breath of Eons cooldown by 1.5s per target struck (was 1s).
Augmentation Evoker The Midnight Season 1 2-set bonus no longer increases the duration that Eruption extends Ebon Might.
Devastation Evoker Scalecommander Wingleader now reduces Deep Breath cooldown by 1s per target struck (was 0.5s).
Hunter (all specs) Hunter's Mark can now only be applied to 1 target at a time — reverting the Season 2 experiment that raised it to 5 (created more problems than it solved).
Beast Mastery Hunter Beast Cleave now causes your pets to strike nearby enemies for 55% of the damage dealt (was 40%).

Marksmanship Hunter Windrunner Quiver redesigned (Rapid Fire +10%, 30% chance to grant Lock and Load); Incendiary Ammunition redesigned (Explosive Shot 100% chance to grant Lock and Load); all ability and auto-shot damage +5%; Multi-Shot -20%.

Survival Hunter Grenade Juggler redesigned (Boomstick increases Wildfire Bomb cooldown recovery rate by 60% for 8s); Wildfire Shells now reduces Wildfire Bomb cooldown by 3s (was 5s); Sentinel Open Fire redesigned (+5% Fire damage).
Arcane Mage Apex Talent Prismatic Bolt damage to the primary target reduced by 20%; Sunfury Glorious Incandescence now summons a Meteorite for every 5 stacks of Arcane Salvo consumed (was 6).

Protection Paladin Reflection of Radiance's activation chance significantly reduced; bug fixes to Sentinel decay, Quickened Invocation, Glory of the Vanguard, and Hammer of Light/Consecration interactions.
Retribution Paladin Divine Storm damage increased by 10%.
Assassination Rogue All damage dealt increased by 6%; Apex Talent Implacable (Rank 3) Implacable Strike +15%.
Assassination Rogue The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus — Amplifying Poison increases melee damage by 3% per stack (was 2%).
Outlaw Rogue All damage increased by 3%; Audacity now increases Ambush damage by 80% (was 60%); Summarily Dispatched now increases Dispatch damage by 15%/30% (was 10%/20%).
Subtlety Rogue Goremaw's Bite initial damage +125% and bleed damage +125%; mirrored damage from Finishing Moves increased to 20% (was 10%).

Restoration Shaman Resto rework: new talent Swelling Tides; Unleash Life healing +100%; Riptide direct +25% / periodic +100%; Healing Rain now heals up to 6 targets (was 5); Farseer Chain Heal now bounces to 5 targets (was 3) with +50% healing; Calm Waters removed; Season 1 2-set now +50% Unleash Life direct healing (was +100%).
Restoration Shaman The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — Bonus Healing Rains now last 8 seconds (was 10 seconds); the 4-set bonus Condensation absorb amount reduced by 30%.

Affliction Warlock New talent Impetuous Wrath (Shadow Bolt/Drain Soul/Malefic Grasp +10%, or +20% vs Haunt targets); Shard Instability redesigned (20% chance for a free instant Unstable Affliction/Seed of Corruption); Nocturnal Yield removed.
Demonology Warlock Diabolist Chaos Salvo, Felseeker, Wicked Cleave, and Eye Explosion damage each reduced by 20%; Flames of Xoroth now increases Fire and demon damage by 3% (was 4%).

Arms Warrior Dreadnaught updated to pure AoE (no longer damages your Overpower target) with +100% damage; Cleave -10%; Slayer Opportunist now grants 20% damage and 20% crit damage to your next Overpower (was 10% each).
Arms Warrior Fixed an issue with the Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus causing Concussive Slam to trigger Mortal Wounds (bug fix).
Fury Warrior Rampaging Ruin damage increased by 50%; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast +10% and Ground Current +150%.
Protection Warrior All ability damage increased by 5%; Revenge +20%; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast +10%.

Systems (not spec-scored) — Season 2 Mythic+ dungeon testing July 21–27 (Altar of Fangs, Murder Row, Den of Nalorakk, Voidscar Arena, The Blinding Vale, Temple of Sethraliss, Kings' Rest, Ruby Life Pools); Vaults of Atal'Utek Corrosive Power unlock smoothing; Delve Coffer Key Shard retuning; PvP (Battleground healing -20%, Solo Shuffle/Blitz queue-miss debuff, Blade's Edge Arena returns) and UI (map coordinates, /mappin sharing) notes.

builds.label: Week of July 14th — Class Changes & Tier Sets (Rogue added in forum post #15): PvE tuning for Demon Hunter, Druid, Evoker, Hunter (Survival Flamefang-Pitch removal + rework), Mage, Paladin, Priest, Shaman, Warlock, Rogue; plus Season 2 systems (Corrosive Power / Coiled Isle), M+ Season 2 boss tuning, and PvP/UI notes.
highlights: Havoc Demon Hunter Inertia effect now increases damage by 12% for 6 seconds (was 18% for 5 seconds).
Devourer Demon Hunter Hungering Slash now properly gives a temporary charge of Vengeful Retreat rather than a free cast that also resets its cooldown (bug fix).

Restoration Druid The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus redesigned — Nature’s Swiftness, Tranquility, and Incarnation: Tree of Life or Convoke the Spirits have a 100% chance to grant Genesis, and its duration is increased by 4 seconds.
Guardian Druid Fixed Mangle consuming Ravage procs and Dream Guide being consumed by Reinvigoration Regrowths (bug fixes).
Preservation Evoker Fixed Time Dilation not clearing its stored damage on death (bug fix).
Beast Mastery Hunter Beast Cleave can no longer be cancelled.
Marksmanship Hunter Explosive Shot damage increased by 100%, but now only explodes for 50% of the damage done to other nearby enemies.
Survival Hunter Flamefang Pitch has been removed; new talent Bombardier increases Wildfire Bomb damage, critical strike chance, and critical damage by 15%.
Survival Hunter Wildfire Shells now grants 5 seconds of Wildfire Bomb cooldown reduction (was 2 seconds); Lunge now increases Agility by 3% (was 2%).
Survival Hunter The Venomous Abyss 2-set and 4-set bonuses reworked around Mongoose Fury and Boomstick; Pack Leader Hogstrider now lasts 1 minute (was 20 seconds).
Arcane Mage Fixed Refractive Images not clearing its stored damage on death (bug fix).
Fire Mage The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — fixed a Pyroblast Hot Streak critical-strike interaction with Pyroclasm (bug fix).

Protection Paladin Hammer and Anvil damage reduced by 20%; Bulwark of Righteous Fury now increases Shield of the Righteous damage by 10% per stack (was 20%); 4-set now deals 100% additional damage on a critical strike (was 200%).
Holy Priest Flash Heal and Prayer of Healing mana costs reduced by 10%; Apex Talent Benediction healing increased by 15% and its availability spread beyond Apotheosis.
Shadow Priest Idol of N’Zoth now generates 2 Insanity (was 4) at 50 stacks and 6 (was 12) at 100 stacks; Archon Focused Outburst Void Volley now 25% effectiveness (was 100%).
Restoration Shaman Healing Rain healing increased by 20% and Healing Wave by 10%, while Totemic bonuses to Healing Rain were lowered (Surging Totem now +10%, was +20%).
Affliction Warlock New talent Hedonic Gorging (+10% Drain Life, Siphon Life adds +10% Corruption damage, Dark Harvest channels 10% faster and +15% damage); Patient Zero has been removed.
Destruction Warlock All damage reduced by 5%; the Venomous Abyss 4-set now makes targets hit by Echo of Sargeras take 6% increased damage from your spells and abilities.

Outlaw Rogue Killing Spree reworked — duration no longer increases from spending combo points beyond your maximum; each extra combo point now increases damage by 15%, and Adrenaline Rush speeds up its execution by 20%.
Systems (not spec-scored) — Season 2 Corrosive Power / Coiled Isle soul system, all Season 2 dungeons on M0/M+ for testing, Mythic Venomous Abyss raid testing continues, plus PvP and UI notes.
Shadow Priest — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus has been redesigned: Tentacle Slam has a 100% chance to grant a free use of Void Volley at 125% effectiveness.

builds.label: Follow-up notes (forum post #13): PvP-only talent adjustments + item note (no PvE class tuning)
highlights: PvP only (out of scope for this tracker's PvE ratings) — Restoration Druid: Call of Ohn'ahra now increases Nature's Swiftness cooldown by 30s (was 10s). Evoker: Swoop Up PvP talent removed. Hunter: Hunting Pack radius 30yd (was 15yd); Chimaeral Sting no longer applies subsequent effects when dispelled; Roar of Sacrifice reduces PvP damage taken by 25% (was 15%). Mage: Improved Mass Invisibility CDR 3min (was 4min); Ring of Fire duration 4s (was 3s); Arcanosphere damage +25%; Overpowered Barrier absorption +60% (was +100%).
Items — Trinketaur now also offers Nebulous Voidcores for PTR testing.

builds.label: Follow-up notes (forum post #12): Unholy DK tuning bug fix + housing wipe/import
highlights: Unholy Death Knight — Dev note: "We're resolving a bug that affected Unholy Death Knight's tuning and making additional adjustments to our latest tuning pass as a result." The overall damage reduction from the 07-08 (build 68569) tuning pass is corrected from −8% to −3% (i.e. the original −8% blanket nerf was itself buggy and overshot).

Unholy Death Knight — Fixed Nazgrim's Conquest incorrectly granting additional Strength when Magus of the Dead is sacrificed for Lord of the Dead; Nazgrim's Conquest no longer grants Strength from critters/low-level targets.
Non-class: Housing wiped and re-importable from live (Character Copy → 'Copy Account Data'); Blueprints available for testing again.

builds.label: Weekly PTR build (Build 68569): post-Heroic-testing tuning — over-performers nerfed (Frost DK, Unholy DK, Havoc DH, Subtlety Rogue, Retribution Paladin) and under-performers buffed (Marksmanship Hunter, Fire Mage, Destruction Warlock, Devourer DH, Balance Druid, Arms Warrior); Blood DK tier set implemented, Scalecommander Wingleader CDR reworked, Discipline Void Shield power redistributed, Mythic raid + Season 2 dungeon testing opens Per-spec and class-wide lines backfilled 2026-08-01 from the original forum post (the entry was under-distilled at seeding). Tier-set lines are deliberately excluded from this backfill: spec.tierSet already carries each set's current state with its own date and source, and backfilling historical set lines would fire the upkeep gate on specs whose sets are already current.
highlights: Frost Death Knight — All ability damage reduced by 10%; melee damage reduced by 20%; Obliterate −10%, Icy Death Torrent −35%, Remorseless Winter −30% (over-performance nerf after first Heroic raid testing).
Unholy Death Knight — All damage reduced by 8%; Lord of the Dead −25%, Magus of the Dead −15%, and several plague/ghoul abilities −15–25%.

Blood Death Knight — The previously announced Venomous Abyss tier set is now implemented: 2-set builds Blood Debt on Death Strike (Strength up to 5%, then a 10%-Strength Marrowrend at 10 stacks); 4-set grants +3 Bone Shield and Shadow AoE.
Marksmanship Hunter — Big damage buffs to close the gap: Multi-Shot +80%, Steady Shot +50%, Kill Shot +25%, Rapid Fire / Volley / Auto Shot +20%, Arcane Shot +15%.
Beast Mastery Hunter — Cobra Shot base damage +30% and Auto Shot +20%, but Serpentine Strikes, Cobra Senses, Hogstrider, and the 4-set single-target bonus were all reduced; Barbed Shot −12%.
Fire Mage — All ability damage increased by 12%; Pyroclasm duration increased to 20 seconds (was 15).
Destruction Warlock — All damage increased by 10%.
Devourer Demon Hunter — All ability damage increased by 10% (Havoc Demon Hunter −5%).
Balance Druid — All damage +3.5% with DoT/builder buffs (Moonfire / Sunfire / Wrath +10%, Starfire +20%) so its profile isn't purely spender-driven.
Retribution Paladin — All damage reduced by 6%; the Venomous Abyss 4-set reworked around Divine Arbiter (damage +35%).
Discipline Priest — Void Shield absorption −30% with the power redistributed across the kit (all healing/absorption +10%, Ultimate Penitence +30%, Atonement 32%).

Evoker — Scalecommander's Wingleader redesigned (per-target Deep Breath / Breath of Eons CDR replaces the old spread-Bombardment mechanic), with Command Squadron and Maneuverability buffed to compensate.
Arms Warrior — Single-target buffs into Slayer: melee auto-attack +100%, 2-set now boosts Mortal Strike and Execute, Slayer's Dominance proc chance 25% (was 15%).
Protection Warrior — 4-set Bloody Rebuke bleed +100% plus a Defensive Stance survivability bump; Colossus buffed to close the gap with Mountain Thane.
Balance Druid — The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus: instant Starfall damage increased by 15%.

Restoration Druid — The Venomous Abyss 2-set: Genesis increases healing over time by 15% (was 25%); 4-set redesigned: Nature's Swiftness, Tranquility, and Ironbark have a 100% chance to grant Genesis, and its duration is increased by 4 seconds.
Frost Mage — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus has been updated: now generates 5 Icicles over 1 second when it triggers, rather than immediately granting the Glacial Spike! effect.
Holy Paladin — The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus now increases the effectiveness of Infusion of Light by 100% (was 75%).
Enhancement Shaman — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus aura Short Circuit now increases the damage of the Crash Lightning weapon-enhancement effect, averaged across stacks.
Affliction Warlock — The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus has been updated: Seed of Corruption now applies Unstable Affliction at 20% effectiveness to your target (was 50%).
Frost Death Knight All ability damage reduced by 10%; melee damage reduced by 20%; Icy Death Torrent damage reduced by 35%; Remorseless Winter damage reduced by 30%; Obliterate damage reduced by 10%.

Unholy Death Knight All damage reduced by 8%; Lord of the Dead damage reduced by 25%; Magus of the Dead reduced by 15%; all Lesser Ghoul damage reduced by 15%; Putrefy reduced by 15%; Necrotic Coil reduced by 18%; Pestilence, Infected Claw, and Virulent Plague reduced by 25%; Rider of the Apocalypse Whitemane Death Coil and Whitemane Undeath reduced by 25%.
Devourer Demon Hunter All ability damage increased by 10%.
Havoc Demon Hunter All ability damage reduced by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat.

Balance Druid All damage dealt increased by 3.5%; Moonfire, Sunfire, Shooting Stars, and Wrath damage increased by 10%; Starfire damage increased by 20%; Umbral Intensity now increases Wrath and Starfire damage by 12% (was 10%); Meteorites damage increased by 15%; Apex Talent: Ascendant Eclipses' Solar Bolt and Lunar Bolt damage increased by 10%; Keeper of the Grove Sylvan Beckoning Dryad's Starfall to 250% effectiveness (was 200%) and Spirit of the Thicket increases Starfall damage by 18% (was 12%).
Restoration Druid Mastery: Harmony healing bonus increased by 15%.

Evoker (class-wide) Scalecommander Wingleader redesigned - Mass Disintegrate and Mass Eruption now reduce the remaining cooldown of Deep Breath and Breath of Eons by 0.5 and 1 second per target struck; Command Squadron's Pyre damage increased by 40%; Maneuverability's damage over time increased by 40%.
Augmentation Evoker Chronowarden Double-time updated - reapplying it with Ebon Might while already active now extends its duration instead of overwriting the previous effect.

Preservation Evoker Inner Flame increases periodic healing by 50% (was 60%); Spiritual Clarity reduces Dream Breath's cooldown by 6 seconds (was 10 seconds); Flameshaper Expanded Lungs increases Dream Breath healing by 20% (was 30%), Conduit of Flame increases critical chance by 10% (was 15%), Fulminous Roar deals damage 15% more often (was 20%), Fluttering Seedlings can now trigger Consume Flame, and Consume Flame heals for 300% of the amount consumed (was 200%).

Beast Mastery Hunter Auto Shot damage increased by 20%; Cobra Shot damage increased by 30%; Serpentine Strikes now increases Cobra Shot's critical strike damage by 20% (was 50%); Cobra Senses now increases Cobra Shot's damage by 10% (was 35%); Barbed Shot damage reduced by 12%; Pack Leader Hogstrider now increases the next Cobra Shot by 100% (was 200%) and Hoof and Blade increases that bonus by 25% (was 50%).

Marksmanship Hunter Auto Shot, Rapid Fire, and Volley damage increased by 20%; Steady Shot damage increased by 50%; Arcane Shot damage increased by 15%; Multi-Shot damage increased by 80%; Kill Shot damage increased by 25%; Dark Ranger Black Arrow damage increased by 25%.
Fire Mage All ability damage increased by 12%; Pyroclasm duration increased to 20 seconds (was 15 seconds).
Mistweaver Monk Spinning Crane Kick damage increased by 10%; resolved an issue that caused Temple Training's Spinning Crane Kick damage increase to apply to Mistweaver.
Windwalker Monk Combat Wisdom now increases Stamina by 5%; Calming Presence now reduces damage taken by 10% (was 6%).

Paladin (class-wide) Lightsmith Divine Guidance updated - for each Holy Power ability cast, your next Consecration deals Holy damage immediately split across all enemies, and up to 3 nearby allies are each healed for a percentage of the total damage.

Holy Paladin All healing increased by 8%; Word of Glory and Eternal Flame healing increased by 5%; Holy Shock healing increased by 10%; Ringing of the Heavens now casts Divine Toll at 200% effectiveness (was 100%); Truth Prevails healing increased by 30%; Saved by the Light absorb increased by 50%; Tirion's Devotion now reduces Lay on Hands' cooldown by 40% (was 30%); Awakening now activates on a 15% chance (was 10%); Glistening Radiance now absorbs 2% of max health up to 6% (was 1% up to 5%); Overflowing Light now transfers 50% of Holy Shock's healing (was 30%); Call of the Righteous now decreases Avenging Wrath's duration by 3 seconds (was 4) and Avenging Crusader's by 2 seconds per point (was 2.5).

Protection Paladin Fixed an issue where Blessed Word's increase to Word of Glory healing applied without being talented; Valiant Crusade no longer cancels on death; Blessed Word's overhealing effect now works on any target; Guardian of Ancient Kings initial cooldown increased to 8 seconds; Improved Ardent Defender now applies a debuff to indicate when fatal damage has been sustained; many talent locations adjusted.
Retribution Paladin All damage reduced by 6%.

Discipline Priest Void Shield absorption reduced by 30%; Ultimate Penitence damage and healing increased by 30%; Greater Smite duration increased to 4 seconds (was 2 seconds); all healing and absorption increased by 10%; Atonement heals for 32% of damage done (was 30%).
Holy Priest All healing increased by 10%; Benediction mana cost reduced by 30%; Apotheosis now reduces the mana cost of Holy Words by 70% (was 50%).
Shadow Priest All ability damage done increased by 8%.
Subtlety Rogue All ability damage reduced by 8%. Does not affect PvP combat.

Restoration Shaman Acid Rain damage increased by 50% but now deals damage every 2 seconds (was 1 second); fixed Healing Rain not causing immediate healing on cast, and both Acid Rain and Healing Rain not granting a partial tick when a Healing Rain naturally expired.
Destruction Warlock All damage increased by 10%.

Warrior (class-wide) Apex Talent Colossus - No Stranger to Pain now increases damage prevented by each use of Ignore Pain by 30% (was 20%); Dominance of the Colossus now causes enemies damaged by Demolish to deal 20% reduced damage to you for 10 seconds (was 10%).
Arms Warrior Melee auto-attack damage increased by 100%; Slayer's Dominance chance to trigger a Slayer's strike increased to 25% (was 15%).

Guardian Druid Fixed an issue where Wild Guardian was not correctly increasing Thrash and Mangle damage while a spirit was active.
Marksmanship Hunter Explosive Shot damage increased by 15%, moving more of the tier set bonus into the base ability to increase its baseline value.

Holy Paladin Eternal Flame and Word of Glory healing increased by 15%; all damage increased by 20%; Judgment and Hammer of Wrath damage increased by 25%; Avenging Crusader now transfers 55% of healing done (was 80%); Pillar of Light's Beacon of Virtue healing increased by 50%; Shield of the Righteous mana return increased by 25%; Unworthy debuff now lasts 18 seconds (was 15 seconds).

Warlock (class-wide) Hellcaller Blackened Soul damage increased by 45% and Wither damage increased by 25%, in response to the previous week's Hellcaller functionality changes.

highlights: Frost Death Knight — Howling Blast damage increased by 100%. This does not apply to PvP combat.

Discipline Priest New Talent: Grim Deliverance - Shadow Mend heals 30% more and applies Atonement for 4 additional seconds but its cast time is increased by 0.5 seconds; Shadow Mend redesigned into a passive upgrade - Flash Heal is upgraded to Shadow Mend rather than triggering from Shadow Word: Pain damage; Apex Talent: Master the Darkness (Rank 3) updated - Mind Blast now upgrades your next Power Word: Shield to Void Shield, Void Shield's chance from Penance reduced to 25% (was 33%) and its reflect reduced to 15% (was 25%), and the talent can now accumulate 2 charges; Flash Heal healing increased by 25%; Smite damage increased by 40%; Inescapable Torment damage reduced by 30%; Penance no longer applies Atonement when cast on an ally; Greater Smite is now a 1-point talent; Oracle Unfolding Vision redesigned to jump expiring shields to an injured ally; Voidweaver Void Blast damage +25%, Voidwraith +30%, Void Infusion Atonement bonus to 75% (was 50%).

Holy Priest Divine Hymn now additionally grants Guardian Spirit while channeled, extending an existing Guardian Spirit by 5 seconds; Archon Resonant Energy redesigned - creating a Halo increases healing done by 2% for 10 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Shadow Priest New Talent: Shadeburst - Shadowy Apparitions that reach your primary target explode for Shadow damage within 8 yards (reduced beyond 5 targets); Improved Voidform redesigned - Voidform grants an additional 5% spell damage and 2 additional uses of Void Volley; Ancient Madness redesigned - Shadow Word: Madness increases Haste during Voidform by 2% and its duration by 1.5 seconds, stacking 5 times, with the Haste lingering and decaying over 10 seconds; Voidform now grants 3 uses of Void Volley instead of Void Volley having a cooldown; Power Word: Shield absorb increased by 25%; Phantom Menace removed; Archon Focused Outburst redesigned - Void Volley deals 15% increased damage and Shadow Word: Madness during Voidform unleashes a Void Volley.

Rogue (class-wide) Thistle Tea is now a choice talent between the existing auto-casting version and a new actively-cast-only version; Atrophic Poison now reduces damage dealt by 4% (was 3%) with duration increased to 60 seconds (was 10, unchanged in PvP); Fatebound Deal Fate now has a 60% chance to grant an extra combo point when you Seal Fate (was 100%).

Assassination Rogue New Talent: Unstable Toxin - Envenom damage increased by 18% but its duration reduced by 2 seconds; Apex Talent: Implacable (Rank 1) updated - Envenom damage increased by 10% and now restores 2 Energy per combo point spent; Internal Bleeding now triggers from Kidney Shot and Rupture with damage increased by 10%; Iron Wire now silences for 5 seconds on stealth or Improved Garrote Garrotes; Dashing Scoundrel now increases weapon poison critical chance by 10% (was 5%) and grants 4% Energy generation per lethal poison; all damage dealt increased by 3%; Deathmark increases Rupture, Garrote, and Lethal Poison damage by 75% (was 100%); Kingsbane damage reduced by 15%; Shrouded Suffocation to 30% (was 20%); Avulsion to 25% (was 20%); Motivated Murderer Energy to 30% (was 20%); Rapid Injection to 20%/40% (was 15%/30%); Blindside chance reduced to 10% (was 15%) and 20% at low health (was 30%); Deadly Momentum removed.

Outlaw Rogue Improved Between the Eyes now causes Between the Eyes critical strikes to deal 2.5 times normal damage (was 3 times); Fast Action now reduces Between the Eyes' cooldown by 8 seconds (was 5) and adds 1% damage per stack; Killing Spree damage increased by 60%; Heavy Hitter increases combo-point-generating attack damage by 15%/30% (was 10%/20%); Zero In value per stack reduced to 2% (was 3%); Hidden Opportunity's Ambush chance increased to 100% of the Sinister Strike chance (was 80%).

Subtlety Rogue Relentless Strikes now generates 4 Energy per combo point spent (was 5); Shadowcraft no longer stores an additional combo point and its auto-attack frequency bonus increased to 75% (was 40%); Lingering Shadow now also applies to Shuriken Storm; Apex Talent: Ancient Arts now considers the total damage of Secret Technique when creating a shadow clone rather than only its initial hit. Aimed at reducing resource over-capping during cooldown windows.
Shaman (class-wide) Farseer Chain Lightning now hits up to 5 targets (was 3) and Farseer Lava Burst now also increases damage by a percent equal to your critical strike chance.

Elemental Shaman Power of the Maelstrom redesigned - Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning have a 15% chance to make your next Lava Burst deal 20% increased damage, stacking twice; Stormkeeper redesigned - your next 2 Lightning Bolts become instant and deal 150% increased damage, or your next 2 Chain Lightnings become instant and Elemental Overload all targets; Lava Burst and Lightning Bolt damage increased by 30% (not in PvP); Chain Lightning and Flame Shock damage increased by 60%; Tempest direct damage reduced by 20%; Ascendance now increases Elemental Overload damage by 30% (was 75%) and its bonus Lava Bursts are 50% value (was 100%); Molten Wrath reduced to 10% (was 15%); Apex Talent: Feedback Loop (Rank 1) now +10% Elemental Overload (was 35%) plus 10% Elemental damage, Rank 2 now 15%/30% critical damage (was 25%/50%); Elemental Blast from Fusion of the Elements now grants 40% buff duration (was 100%); Stormbringer Supercharge redesigned - Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Tempest overloads deal 10% additional damage.
Enhancement Shaman Healing Surge, Earth Shield, and Healing Stream Totem healing increased by 25%. Self-sustain rescaling alongside the +25% player-health change.

Restoration Shaman Healing Rain now has a 12 second cooldown and an 18 second duration, and recasting it despawns the previous one; this cooldown change does not affect the Totemic Surging Totem's Healing Rain.

Warlock (class-wide) Summon Demonic Gateway is now a Utility spell by default in the Cooldown Manager; Hellcaller Blackened Soul redesigned - if the target is afflicted with your Wither, Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1, and each stack gain has a chance to collapse Wither, consuming a stack every second to deal Shadowflame damage until 1 stack remains; Mark of Peroth'arn redesigned - Wither critical strikes deal 215% damage and Blackened Soul critical strikes deal 225% instead of the usual 200%.

Destruction Warlock Conflagration of Chaos redesigned - Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critically strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance; Apex Talent: Embers of Nihilam (Rank 1) tooltip now shows the percent chance of Incinerate evoking an Echo of Sargeras.

Warrior (class-wide) The Rend ability is now exclusive to Arms, has returned to being single-target, and its Rage cost is reduced to 10; Cleave applies Rend to all targets if the Warrior knows Rend; New Talent (Fury): Storm of Blood - Whirlwind applies Rend to all targets, and Crashing Thunder extends it to Thunder Clap for Mountain Thane; New Talent (Protection): Blood and Thunder - Thunder Clap applies Rend to all targets; Thunder Clap no longer innately applies Rend if known.

Arms Warrior Ravager damage increased by 50%, no longer increases Cleave and Whirlwind damage, now causes enemies it damages to take 25% increased Bleed damage for 12 seconds, and its duration is no longer reduced by Haste; Bloodletting updated - abilities have a 5% increased critical chance against Rend targets, Mortal Strike inflicts Rend below 35% health, and Deep Wounds lasts 33% longer; Broad Strokes now grants 6 stacks of Sweeping Strikes on Colossus Smash; Improved Sweeping Strikes removed; Mass Execution and Overpowering Finish are now a choice node; Colossus Tide of Battle now increases Overpower and Execute damage, Demolish cooldown reduced to 30 seconds (was 45), and Dominance of the Colossus no longer reduces it.

Fury Warrior Whirlwind now generates 3 Rage innately and Improved Whirlwind instead adds 1 Rage per target hit up to 8; New Talent: Carving Blades - Whirlwind deals 50% additional damage against a single target, on a choice node with Meat Cleaver; Rampaging Ruin redesigned - while Improved Whirlwind is active, Rampage's final strike slams the ground for Physical damage within 8 yards (reduced beyond 5 targets); Hack and Slash updated - Rampage now has a 75% chance to refund a Raging Blow charge and increase its damage by 20%; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast damage increased by 40% and Crashing Thunder reduced to 10% Thunder Clap damage (was 30%).

Protection Warrior Devastating Focus now increases Revenge and Execute damage to the target (was Revenge only); Bloodborne now increases all Bleed damage (was only Rend and Deep Wounds); Fueled by Violence heals you for 125% of Bleed damage dealt (was 110%); Ignore Pain absorb increased by 25%; Brutal Vitality adds 10% of damage dealt to Ignore Pain (was 8%); Ravager damage increased by 50%, no longer increases Revenge and Thunder Clap damage, now causes enemies it damages to take 25% increased Bleed damage for 12 seconds, and its duration is no longer Haste-reduced; Colossus Demolish cooldown reduced to 30 seconds (was 45) and Tide of Battle now increases Revenge and Execute damage; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast damage increased by 40% and Crashing Thunder reduced to 10% (was 30%).
